title: sfi conformance transcript
description: What tools/sfi/conformance/prelude.lua's T.transcript() returns. Written by Kiln's interpreter (crates/sfi) and by ShroudForge's own mod runtime (in a local differential test, not published) for the same fixture; two transcripts are compared as JSON text after parsing (key order is fixed by the prelude). SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

fixture_error.description: Present when the fixture chunk itself raised.

ok.description: call: whether the function returned instead of raising.

error.description: call with ok=false: the original canonical error value, unchanged by message extraction.

message.description: v2 failed calls only: directly available string or protected __tostring text, normalized by the shared prelude. Absent (not null) if there is no safe text or diagnostics fail. Never derived from the canonical error class.

pass.description: expect: whether the value equals the expected one.

v.description: boolean: the value; integer: decimal text; float: 16 hex digits of the big-endian IEEE-754 bits, or inf, -inf, nan; string: Lua %q text; table: [[key, value], ...] sorted by the JSON text of the key.

mt.description: table: whether it has a metatable.

name.description: userdata: its metatable's __name, or ? when it has none or it is protected.
